# dsh-llms-forge

Generate llms.txt for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin repositories from package.json + README — AI-readable discovery files with zero runtime dependencies.

- Install into dsh: `dsh plugin add dsh-llms-forge`
- CLI: `npx dsh-llms-forge . --write --overwrite`
- Agent tool: `llms_forge(dir, options)` — returns dsh-llms-forge/v1 results
- Read-only by default; writing requires options.write / --write
- Complements llms-txt-forge (standalone) with an in-harness tool
